notes.title: Small update for 32-bit compatibility
notes.content: Fixed a bug with 32-bit compatibility on Windows.

notes.title: Re-Launch Update
notes.content:
How To Make A Killing has been re-launched by the Tired Gamers scholarship program. As part of this, there has been a large visual update to the game along with game mechanics changes. Stun-lock has been added to some enemies along with turtle quest updates and dialogue changes. The town of Hamelin is under the threat of the Necromancer and needs you to save it!

Along with this update, we have discounted the game by 50% for a short time.
